name: Everything Nice (Spiced-Rum Coffee With Butterscotch Whipped Cream)

ingredients.name: malted milk powder, such as Carnation

instructions.primary_message: Combine heavy cream, malted milk powder, brown sugar, and salt in a mixing bowl or bowl of a stand mixer. Beat, using the whisk attachment, electric beaters, or a whisk, until dry ingredients are evenly incorporated and cream forms soft peaks.

Combine hot coffee, spiced rum, and simple syrup in a prewarmed mug. (You can prewarm it by pouring hot water into it, letting it stand for 1 minute, then draining.) Using a spoon, dollop whipped cream on top of coffee and top with freshly grated nutmeg, if using. Serve right away. (You may have more whipped cream than the mug can accommodate; feel free to add more as you drink, or use some for the next round.)

schema_metadata.keywords: irish coffee, everything nice, spiced rum, everything nice recipe

description: In Everything Nice—a variation on a classic Irish coffee—spiced rum takes the place of whiskey, lending its sweet, spiced caramel flavor to the coffee's roasted, bitter bite.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Freshly grated nutmeg, for garnish (optional)

Notes: To make a 2:1 simple syrup, combine 1/2 cup granulated sugar with 1/4 cup water in a small saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring, until sugar is fully dissolved. You can add the syrup hot, since the drink is hot; any extra can be stored in the refrigerator up to three months, and often longer.
author: Daniel Gritzer
